fills.researcher_notes: Company-level Operator question for the Delfin brief (this brief's only Delfin row). Owner is already correctly 'Delfin LNG LLC [100.%]' on the sheet; Operator was blank. Source 1 (Rigzone, trade press, 2025-04-14): 'The US Department of Transportation's Maritime Administration (MARAD) ... issued a license to Delfin LNG, LLC for the construction and operation of the nation's first offshore LNG export deepwater port' -- MARAD's own licensee of record for construction/operation is Delfin LNG, LLC. Source 2 (Offshore Magazine, distinct trade-press publisher, same MARAD license event): confirms 'Delfin LNG' as the licensed operating entity, parented by Delfin Midstream Inc. Both independently name the operating subsidiary the same way; Delfin Midstream Inc. is the ultimate parent (per Delfin Midstream's own site and DOE filings) but Delfin LNG LLC is the specific licensee/operator entity, matching both the wiki lead and the sheet's existing Owner spelling -- staged Operator with the identical string so Owner and Operator read as the same 100%-owned operating entity, as is typical for this kind of single-purpose project company. This pipeline is the ex-UTOS 30-mile, 42-inch line Delfin purchased in 2014 to deliver gas to its FLNG vessels; both sources are about the broader Delfin LNG deepwater-port licensee, which is also the entity that controls this feeder pipeline -- I found no separate operating entity named for the pipeline segment itself in any source, consistent with a single-project-company structure.
